# Gourmet Coffee Brand: Client Case Study

**Case Study Type:** B2C  
**Industry:** Food & Beverage  
**Company Type:** Gourmet coffee subscription brand  
**Company Size:** 23 Employees  
**Digital Marketing Services Provided:** SEO Management, Content Marketing, PPC Management, Social Media Management

## The Clients Challenge:

The coffee brand had excellent customer satisfaction, but they were struggling to reach a new audience beyond just word-of-mouth referrals. Their SEO visibility was poor for their website and the paid social campaigns were expensive, with minimal ROI. They needed a new strategy to grow subscriptions and brand awareness nationally while keeping their costs of acquisitions in check.

## Brick Marketing Strategy:

Brick Marketing built a brand new keyword strategy which targeted phrases like “best coffee subscription”, “single-origin beans” and any queries that related to the company. We created brand new blog content around brewing methods and taste profiles. Then launched a retargeting ad funnel and improved their websites landing page conversions with trust elements that they needed, like reviews and certifications.

## Client Results Achieved:

We helped build up a 175% increase in organic traffic which created a 2 times growth in subscriptions. This resulted in a 40% drop in cost per subscriber and we were able to achieve first-page rankings for 20+ keywords. There was also 4x higher social media engagement and referral sales.

## Why it worked:

This strategy worked because Brick Marketing connected passion with performance. By using SEO to build credibility and storytelling content to try and appeal to people’s senses. We built up interest and trust before anyone made a purchase. The optimized funnel blended education, discovery and a sense of urgency. This helped the brand compete with larger far players without overspending on ads.

Bottega Coffee Case Study | Shopify eCommerce by 23 Digital

![](https://www.23digital.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/bottega-coffee-case-study-banner.png)

A digital strategy crafted to match the quality of the beans & Machines Bottega Coffee’s journey to scalable eCommerce success with Shopify and full-funnel digital marketing.

# Bottega Coffee: Brewing a Premium D2C Experience with Shopify

Overview

Bottega Coffee is a premium retailer of high-quality coffee machines, grinders, and accessories for coffee enthusiasts in Australia. As a new business, Bottega Coffee sought to establish itself as a trusted brand in the competitive home and professional coffee equipment market. To achieve this, they partnered with 23 Digital to create a seamless, high-converting eCommerce experience on Shopify that would drive sales, enhance customer engagement, and support long-term business growth.

Campaign Length:

12+ Months

Sector:

Coffee, D2C eCommerce, FMCG

Demographic:

Coffee enthusiasts, café owners, home brewers

Resources Involved:

5

Budget:

$25K

Channels:

Organic, Paid Social, Email, Direct Traffic

Services:

Shopify Development, Subscription Integration, CRO, SEO, Brand UX/UI Strategy

Goals:

D2C Growth, Brand Elevation, Subscription Revenue, Increased Repeat Purchases

![detail pattern macbook](https://www.23digital.com.au/wp-content/themes/23digital-theme/assets/images/detail-pattern-macbook.png)

Hover over to view website Touch the screen to view site

01

## The Challenge

Launching a new brand in the specialty coffee equipment industry presented several challenges:

*   **Brand Establishment & Trust** – As a new player in the market, Bottega Coffee needed a website that conveyed credibility and premium quality.
*   **High-Value Product Sales Online** – Selling premium coffee machines and accessories online required a well-optimised eCommerce experience that reassured customers and simplified decision-making.
*   **Education & Product Discovery** – Many customers needed guidance on selecting the right coffee machine and accessories, requiring detailed product pages and educational content.
*   **Mobile-First Shopping Experience** – With a growing number of consumers purchasing via mobile, the store needed to be fully optimised for mobile users.
*   **Scalability for Future Growth** – The website had to support future expansions, including subscription services, loyalty programs, and marketing automation.

02

## The Solution

23 Digital developed a Shopify-based solution designed to position Bottega Coffee as a trusted authority in premium coffee machines and accessories. The key solutions included:

*   **Branding & Visual Identity** – A premium, minimalist brand identity was developed, incorporating elegant typography, sophisticated colour palettes, and high-quality product imagery to reflect the brand’s premium positioning.
*   **Custom Shopify Design & Development** – A modern, conversion-driven Shopify store was designed to showcase Bottega Coffee’s high-end products while ensuring a seamless user experience.
*   **Merchandising & Product Presentation** – Products were strategically organised with clear categorisation, engaging visuals, and compelling product descriptions to enhance discoverability and encourage conversions.
*   **Optimised Product Pages & Filtering System** – Detailed product pages were created with specifications, high-quality imagery, and comparison features to help customers choose the right coffee machine.
*   **Mobile-Optimised Shopping Experience** – A fully responsive design ensured a smooth shopping experience across all devices, particularly mobile.
*   **SEO & Performance Optimisation** – On-page SEO strategies were implemented to improve organic visibility, and the website was optimised for fast loading speeds.
*   **Secure Checkout & Payment Flexibility** – Multiple payment options, including buy-now-pay-later solutions, were integrated to encourage higher-value purchases.
*   **Future-Ready Scalability** – The Shopify platform was configured to allow easy integration of future features such as loyalty programs, email marketing automation, and subscription-based services.

*   UI Elements

## The Results

Since launching, Bottega Coffee’s Shopify store has delivered significant outcomes:

*   **Revenue Growth:** 3.8x increase in monthly online sales within 6 months
*   **Subscription Revenue:** 44% of monthly orders now from subscribers
*   **Conversion Rate:** 49% increase in mobile and tablet conversions
*   **Customer Retention:** 32% increase in repeat purchase rate due to smarter customer flows
*   **Brand Perception:** Stronger market positioning through premium design, storytelling, and user experience

Bottega Coffee now offers a frictionless, beautifully branded online experience that does justice to the quality of its beans—building a loyal, growing customer base across Australia.
